title: Timer/Teleport_Plugin
body:
- It is a timer plugin with a TP function you can use the timer alone or with the TP option. 
- The TP points can be set by yourself. 
- The color of the timer can be changed with a command.
- Additional colors can be added in the config.
- The TP points are calculated based on the players - the players who should not be tp +   additional TP points (default: 5) can be changed in the config.


<details>
<summary>tp.yml</summary>

#Teleport Configuration

additional-tp-points: 5

</details>


<details>
<summary>colors.yml</summary>

colors:

  RED: "§c"
  
  GREEN: "§a"
  
  BLUE: "§9"
  
  YELLOW: "§e"
  
  PURPLE: "§5"
  
  WHITE: "§f"
  
  GRAY: "§7"

</details>
